verdicts.reason: A recomposes reasonably: the headline is large, the subhead sits under it, and the badge sits next to the CTA in a row. But the CTA and badge are jammed against the bottom and right edges, there is dead space at bottom-left under the subhead, and the phone sits tight on the left edge. B packs everything into the upper two-thirds and leaves a large empty orange band at the bottom. Its phone is small and pushed up near the top edge, and the tilted ONLINE ONLY badge nearly touches the CTA because it is stacked under it. The CTA cluster also crowds the right edge, so B looks unbalanced and unfinished.
